from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_create_user

def test_create_user_ok():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    
    # Test retrievability
    assert handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])}) == (200, user)

def test_create_user_trimming():
    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob2@example.com"})
    assert status == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"

def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
    handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "alice@example.com"})
    status, error = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice2", "email": "ALICE@example.com"})
    assert status == 409
    assert error == {"error": "email already exists"}

def test_create_user_invalid_name():
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "test@test.com"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "test@test.com"})[0] == 400

def test_create_user_invalid_email():
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "invalid"})[0] == 400
